properties.description: A schedule trigger failed to fire its pipeline. The most dangerous failure of the three: nothing runs at all and no pipeline appears in the run history, so silence looks identical to success. Sev 1. Window and frequency are both 1h. The first version evaluated a 15-minute window every 5 minutes with autoMitigate on, so three real failures produced a fired/resolved pair roughly every 45 minutes as the same events rolled in and out of the window — alert fatigue from a handful of events. Matching the two means each window is evaluated once.
